Convert a pladdrr object to a matrix

Source: R/as-matrix-fallback.R
as.matrix.PraatObject.Rd

Fallback as.matrix() method for every pladdrr object class: it returns the numbers of the object's own $as_matrix() method (frame x 2 for Pitch and the tiers, frequency x time for Spectrogram and the other 2-D objects, channel x sample for Sound). Classes without $as_matrix() (Formant, PointProcess, TextGrid, Table, ...) raise a pladdrr_input_error naming the class and the accessor to use instead; they never silently return a matrix-shaped wrapper. Matrix and Polygon keep their own methods.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'PraatObject'
as.matrix(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A pladdrr object (any class inheriting from PraatObject).

...

Passed on to the object's $as_matrix() method; used by Spectrogram (include_dimnames) and MelSpectrogram/BarkSpectrogram (to_db).

Value

A numeric matrix. For classes with no $as_matrix(), an error of class pladdrr_input_error instead, naming whichever of as.data.frame(x) and x$as_vector() that class really offers (Manipulation offers neither and is pointed at its own accessors).

See also

Matrix, Pitch, as.data.frame.Sound

Examples

sound <- Sound$create_tone(frequency = 440, duration = 0.2,
  sampling_rate = 16000)
m <- as.matrix(sound$to_pitch())
dim(m)
#> [1] 17  2
tryCatch(as.matrix(sound$to_point_process_periodic_cc()),
  pladdrr_input_error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
#> [1] "class PointProcess has no $as_matrix(); use as.data.frame(x) or x$as_vector() instead (see ?PointProcess)"
